card.name: Linking words before timing or handling instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as during, be, the, after or a space before a number, in drug label sentences about when to use, store or discard a product. The next words are usually a duration, a dose point or a handling instruction.

modes.label: Linking word before a time point
modes.description: Words like after, during or within that lead into a stated time period or event.

modes.label: Should be before handling advice
modes.description: The word be after 'should' leading into how to keep or take the product.
modes.example: alfuzosin hydrochloride extended-release tablets should<< be>> taken with food and with the same meal

modes.label: Space before a duration number
modes.description: A blank gap just before a number of days or weeks in use or storage limits.
modes.example: Use within<< >>30 days after first opening.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about timing, such as bedtime, overnight, getting up and taking a medicine.
card.plain: It fires on small bridging words in label sentences just before a time period or a how-to-take instruction.
